title: Focused implementation review
statement: As a reviewer, I can open focused visual decks from a Report Saga sidebar and inspect the exact code behind each explanation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A report can expose several optional decks without rendering user stories or ordinary report fragments as slides.
Only semantic Items own exact diff evidence, including contextual surprise callouts.
The Saga sidebar names each deck with a deck icon; selecting a deck expands its slide links, and selecting a slide gives it the full main review area.
